description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for the 'git reset --patch' command, using a testing framework with functions like 'test_expect_success' and utilities for setting up git states and verifying them.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided commands and checking for proper execution.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets up the git working directory and index with specified files and saves their state for later verification.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD state for comparison.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the fake clock used for commit timestamps during testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit, typically advancing HEAD to a new commit.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Simulates user input for patch selection prompts, feeding lines like 'n' or 'y'.

methods.name: git reset -p
methods.description: Invokes 'git reset' with patch mode to interactively reset parts of files.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Checks that a specific file's state matches the saved state after an operation.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies the current state of a file matches expected conditions.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, and checks for failure conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches command output for specific text patterns.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the working directory and index to a predefined state.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Checks that the current HEAD matches the saved HEAD state.
